label: Пункт
description: A 10-sentence usage card for пункт (point; item).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Пункт' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Важный' agrees in the masculine nominative and 'договора' is a genitive modifier. A formal model for documents.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пункт' is the accusative direct object of 'обсудим'; inanimate masculine accusative equals the nominative. 'Первый' agrees in the masculine accusative. Useful in meetings.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Пункте' is prepositional after 'в', the place where something is found. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A practical editing phrase.

missions.phrase: Согласно последнему пункту, мы платим вперёд.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Пункту' is dative after 'согласно', meaning according to. 'Последнему' agrees in the masculine dative. A formal contract pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Пункта' is the genitive modifying 'содержание', the content of what. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive. Common in formal review.

missions.phrase: Мы не согласны с этим пунктом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Пунктом' is instrumental after 'с', the thing disagreed with. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A useful negotiation phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Пункты' is the accusative plural object of 'прочитайте', the things to read; inanimate plural accusative equals the nominative. 'Все' is the agreeing quantifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. The numeral 'десять' governs the genitive plural 'пунктов'. 'В списке' sets the location. A clean counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Пункту' is dative after 'к', expressing what one returns to. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative. A natural discussion phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Пунктами' is the instrumental plural after 'между', the things between which something lies. 'Двумя' agrees in the instrumental. Good for analytical language.
